register_all_coco: register all COCO dataset splits including instance detection, keypoints, and open-vocabulary detection variants
register_all_lvis: register LVIS dataset splits for open-set, custom image, and fully supervised object detection tasks

register_all_pascal_voc: register PASCAL VOC dataset splits for 2007 and 2012 train, validation, and test sets
